lead.headline: 987 of 22,770 months where an insider sold $5M+ of stock came 4-9 months before a 50%+ price drop
lead.number: 987 of 22,770 owner-months with $5M+ sold (2015-25) preceded a price at least 50% lower; e.g. Daniel Loeb in Upstart, $712M at $225, later $51.
lead.watch_out: The top of the list is stock splits (Tesla, Walmart, Alphabet), and preset trading plans can't be checked.
